entries.1782df7a64c563f3: Nikkiso is a manufacturer that makes and sells industrial special pumps such as those for liquefied gas, composite parts for aircraft, hemodialysis equipment and other products.
entries.3fef56085c44fce1: The company manufactures and sells industrial special pump systems centered on cryogenic pumps used for liquefied gas, precision equipment such as water quality control systems for power plants, and molded carbon fiber reinforced plastic (CFRP) products for civil aircraft, and also provides maintenance.
entries.5e2875d2fed01d6a: It consists of the Pump Systems Business, which handles industrial pump systems and equipment related to liquefied gas and industrial gases, and the Precision Equipment Business, which handles water quality control systems for power plants and equipment related to electronic component manufacturing.
entries.88a9774fc0bd155c: The company manufactures and sells CFRP molded products and metal-bonded components for civil aircraft.
entries.9ff12b06f304fc28: The company manufactures and sells CFRP molded products and metal-bonded components for civil aircraft. Its products include thrust reverser parts, wing parts, fuselage parts and parts for artificial satellites. Amounts are disclosed only for the industrial segment, and no amount for this business alone is printed.
entries.abea7f77314b2af9: It consists of the Pump Systems Business, which handles industrial pump systems and equipment related to liquefied gas and industrial gases, and the Precision Equipment Business, which handles water quality control systems for power plants and equipment related to electronic component manufacturing. Its products include cryogenic pumps, heat exchangers and vaporizers, and cryogenic process plants. Amounts are disclosed only for the industrial segment, and no amount for this business alone is printed.
entries.b9b6aa945287df6f: The company manufactures and sells products related to hemodialysis, such as hemodialysis machines, dialyzers, blood circuits and powdered dialysis agents, as well as energy devices for microwave surgery, and also provides maintenance. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥78,891 million.

entries.da11d55b2ec0ea14: Its main focus is hemodialysis-related products. It manufactures and sells multipurpose dialysis machines, multi-patient dialysate supply systems, artificial kidney dialysis agents and hollow-fiber dialyzers in Japan and overseas. The medical segment consists only of this business, and its amount is the same as the medical segment amount.
